document.title: Skill: avoid the example read and batch ref verification
document.summary: The skill writes review.json from a field shape in SKILL.md. One shell call verifies the refs, checks the CLI version, and runs review, log, and stat.
document.why: [#108](source:s1) asks the skill to drop a dedicated example.md read and to verify refs in the same shell as review.

sources.title: Skill: avoid the example read and batch ref verification
sources.gist: A Muse session still read example.md, then verified refs in a shell before review.

lookFor: [#108](source:s1) also asks smoke eval to pass and the review to stay valid. This diff states the instructions. The eval trace is the check.

groups.title: Skill workflow
groups.why: [#108](source:s1) names two extra round trips: a read of example.md, and a shell that only verifies refs.
groups.summary: SKILL.md names the field shape and batches git rev-parse --verify with review, log, and stat.
lookFor: Subtle. npm view uses || true, so a failed version query still reaches review. A missing ref stops earlier, because both rev-parse lines use &&.

groups.title: Workflow lock
groups.why: [#108](source:s1) is done when the normal path has no separate example read and no separate ref check. This test fails if those lines leave SKILL.md.
groups.summary: skill.test.ts checks the batched shell and the inline field shape.

commits.subject: Batch ref checks into the review shell and inline the field shape.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The normal write path no longer sends the agent to example.md, and git rev-parse, the CLI version, review, log, and stat run in one shell so a missing ref stops before review.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
